import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long mod = 1000000007;

    static class Mat {
        long[][] a;

        Mat(int size) {
            a = new long[size][size];
        }

        static Mat multiply(Mat x, Mat y, int m) {
            Mat z = new Mat(m);
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    z.a[i][j] = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                        z.a[i][j] = (z.a[i][j] + x.a[i][k] * y.a[k][j]) % mod;
                    }
                }
            }
            return z;
        }

        static Mat power(Mat x, long y, int m) {
            Mat z = new Mat(m);
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    z.a[i][j] = (i == j) ? 1 : 0;
                }
            }
            while (y > 0) {
                if ((y & 1) == 1) {
                    z = multiply(z, x, m);
                }
                x = multiply(x, x, m);
                y >>= 1;
            }
            return z;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();

        long tmp = n;
        int cnt = -1;
        long[] dig = new long[75];

        while (tmp != 0) {
            cnt++;
            dig[cnt] = tmp % m;
            tmp /= m;
        }

        Mat g = new Mat(m + 1);
        g.a[0][m] = 1;

        Mat[][] f = new Mat[75][m];
        Mat[] pre = new Mat[m];
        Mat[] suf = new Mat[m];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                f[0][i] = new Mat(m + 1);
                f[0][i].a[j][i] = 1;
                f[0][i].a[j][j] = 1;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= cnt; i++) {
            pre[0] = f[i - 1][0];
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                pre[j] = Mat.multiply(pre[j - 1], f[i - 1][j], m);
            }
            suf[m - 1] = f[i - 1][m - 1];
            for (int j = m - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                suf[j] = Mat.multiply(f[i - 1][j], suf[j + 1], m);
            }
            f[i][0] = suf[0];
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                f[i][j] = Mat.multiply(suf[j], pre[j - 1], m);
            }
        }

        int cur = 0;
        for (int i = cnt; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (long _ = 0; _ < dig[i]; _++) {
                g = Mat.multiply(g, f[i][cur], m);
                cur = (cur + 1) % m;
            }
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            ans = (ans + g.a[0][i]) % mod;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
